verses.1: On that day, Merodach sent Baladan, the king of Babylon, with letters and gifts to Hizkia. When he heard that Hizkia was sick, he became very worried.
verses.2: And Hizkiah rejoiced over them. He ordered that all the treasures, gold, silver, and other valuables be brought out of his house. There was nothing in his house or in all his possessions that Hizkiah did not see.
verses.3: And the prophet Yeshua went before King Hizkiah. He said to him, “What did these people say? Where do they come from?” Hizkiah replied, “They came to me from a distant land, from Babylon.”
verses.4: And he said, “What did they see in your house? He said, “Hizkiah, everything that was seen in my house was not something that could be seen in my treasures.”
verses.5: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD, O armies!”
verses.6: Now, days are coming when all that is in your houses, and all that your ancestors have stored up until today, will be taken away. Baruch shall not be able to keep anything hidden anymore. As Jehovah has said.
verses.7: And from your descendants who will come out of you, those who will be born, they shall take them and make them servants in the palace of King Babylon.
verses.8: And Hizkiah said to Jeshua, “Good words from the Lord have come from you.” And Jeshua replied, “May peace and truth be in my days.”
